2009 Pac-10 Tournament Most Valuable Player | tournaments = y | tournament_list = [[2009 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|2009 NCAA Tournament]] | awards = | color = DarkRed | fontcolor = Gold }} '''DeMar DeRozan''' (born August 7, 1989) in [[Compton, California|Compton]], [[California]] is an [[United States|American]] [[college basketball]] player for the [[University of Southern California|USC]] [[USC Trojans men's basketball|Trojans]]. ==High School== DeRozan attended [[Compton High School]] and was ranked as one of the top college recruits in the nation from the class of 2008. He was ranked #3 in the nation by [[Rivals.com]] and #6 by Scout.com.[http://scouthoops.scout.com/a.z?s=75&p=9&c=4&pid=88&yr=2008 Scout.com Class of 2008 Basketball Rankings] He played on the varsity basketball team all four years of high school. As a senior he led Compton High School to a 26-6 record, a Moore League title and the CIF Division IAA Southern Section quarterfinals. He averaged 29.2 ppg and 7.9 rpg.[http://www.usabasketball.com/men_team.php?bios=derozan_demar High School Info] DeRozan won the 2008 McDonald's All-American game dunk contest.[http://www.trojannyc.com/2008/03/demar-derozan-w.html DeRozan wins 2008 Mcdonald's All-American Game Dunk Contest] He was a member of the 2008 [[McDonald's All-American Team]]. He had 10 points for the west team. He was also invited to play in the 2008 Jordan Brand Classic at [[Madison Square Garden]], where he had 17 points.[http://blog.newrecruitsports.com/?p=3 Jordan Brand Classic Stats] ==College== In November 2007 DeRozan signed a [[letter of intent]] to play basketball at [[USC Trojans men's basketball|USC]]. He chose USC over [[Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball|Arizona State]] and [[University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill|North Carolina]]. He joined his friend, musician-actor-basketball player [[Romeo Miller]].Jon Weinbach (March 7, 2008). [http://online.wsj.com/article_email/SB120485166974418241-lMyQjAxMDI4MDA0NzgwNTcxWj.html A Hot Prospect?] ''The Wall Street Journal''. Accessed July 28, 2008. In his first game for the Trojans, DeRozan scored a team-high 21 points with seven rebounds in an exhibition game against [[Azusa Pacific]], a 85-64 victory, at the [[Galen Center]].Gary Klein, [http://www.latimes.com/sports/college/usc/la-spw-uschoops4-2008nov04,0,1963970.story DeMar DeRozan lifts USC in exhibition win], ''Los Angeles Times'', November 4, 2008, Accessed November 4, 2008. DeRozan had 14 points in his first career regular season game in a win over [[UC Irvine]].[http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/recap?gameId=283200030&campaign=rss&source=NCBHeadlines DeRozan Scores 14 in Debut] He grabbed 12 rebounds in the Pac-10 Conference opener in which USC defeated [[Oregon Ducks men's basketball|Oregon]], 83-62, on January 2, 2009,[http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/recap?gameId=290022483 Southern Cal 83, Oregon 62 - Recap] and scored a career-high 22 points in a 61-49 win over Arizona State on January 15.[http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/recap?gameId=290150030 Hackett provides defense as Trojans rally, topple No. 15 Sun Devils] ==NBA== On April 8, 2009, DeRozan announced he would enter the [[2009 NBA Draft]] and forego his final three years of eligiblilty at USC. [http://www.ocregister.com/articles/demar-derozan-usc-2358316-nba-draft USC's DeRozan says he's entering NBA draft] ==Awards== *2006 All-Moore League first team *2007 All-Moore League first team *2007 Named to the Los Angeles Times first team *2008 Parade Magazine All-America first team *2008 Long Beach Press-Telegram's Best in the West first team *2008 McDonald's All American West Squad *2008 Jordan Brand All-American Classic *2008 Southern California Interscholastic Basketball Coaches Association I-AA Player of the Year (tie with Jordan Hamilton and David Wear) *2008 MVP of his conference *2008 All-state team ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[http://usctrojans.cstv.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/derozan_demar00.html USC Bio] *[http://nbadraft.net/admincp/profiles/demarderozan.html NBADraft.net Profile] *[http://www.mynbadraft.com/NBA-Draft-Profiles-2009/Demar-DeRozan MyNBADraft.com Profile] *[http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Demar-DeRozan-1319/ DraftExpress.com Profile] *[http://usctrojans.cstv.com/sports/m-baskbl/sched/usc-m-baskbl-sched.html USC Basketball Schedule] {{DEFAULTSORT:Derozan, Demar}} [[Category:1989 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:African American basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from California]] [[Category:People from Compton, California]] [[Category:USC Trojans men's basketball players]] [[Category:McDonald's High School All-Americans]] [[Category:Shooting guards]]
